# Guitar note recordings

The WAV files in this directory are selected notes from the FreePats “Spanish classical guitar” sound bank, version 2019-06-18. The G#3 and F#4 samples support the extended educational excerpt of Hedwig's Theme; F#3 supports the corrected Fixiki melody. G#4 in Baby Shark plays the A4 guitar recording one semitone lower.

- Source: https://freepats.zenvoid.org/Guitar/acoustic-guitar.html
- Creator: roberto@zenvoid.org for the FreePats project
- License: Creative Commons CC0 1.0, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The recordings were made from a real Spanish classical guitar. They are used here for note and melody playback. No third-party recording of any song is included.
